activation_and_option_contract.execution: Only RootExtraction_MACRO iTask=2 reaches the compensation block; RootExtraction_MICRO contains no compensation block.
activation_and_option_contract.micro_guard: read_compensation resets SWCOMPENSATE to 0 and calls swap_error when SWCOMPENSATE>0 and SWDROUGHT>1; compensation with microscopic RWU is rejected.
activation_and_option_contract.switch: SWCOMPENSATE defaults to 0; values 1 and 2 select Jarvis (1989) and Walsum (2020). Deprecated SWJARVIS>0 maps to SWCOMPENSATE=1 with warnings.
activation_and_option_contract.stress_selector: SWSTRESSOR defaults to 1; input range 1..5 maps to all stressors, drought, oxygen, salinity and frost respectively.
activation_and_option_contract.jarvis_configuration: ALPHACRIT is initialized to 1 and read with range/default arguments 0.2..1.0; source compensation runs only when abs(ALPHACRIT-1) >= vsmall.
activation_and_option_contract.walsum_configuration: DCRITRTZ is read as the root-zone depth threshold; per-call ALPHACRIT=min((DCRITRTZ+RDM-RD_NODDRZ)/RDM,1).

exact_macro_order: Initialize root-result/stress arrays and totals; return before calculation if no roots or transpiration below nihil.
Calculate potential nodewise uptake qrot from cumulative root density and ptra.
Per node compute wetness/oxygen, drought, salinity and frost factors; multiply them into qrot and apportion qred into four stress totals.
Complete the pre-compensation qrosum and root-zone stress attribution sums.
If compensation enabled, set Walsum ALPHACRIT if selected, then calculate alptot=qrosum/ptra and qred=ptra-qrosum.
Gate on abs(alphacrit-1)>=vsmall, qred>vsmall and alptot>=vsmall; infer per-stressor factors as alptot**(qred_stress_sum/qred).
For selector 1 compute alptotcom=min(alptot/alphacrit,1); for selectors 2..5 divide only the selected inferred factor by alphacrit, clip it at 1, and multiply the four factors.
Scale each node qrot by alptotcom/alptot; replace qrosum with ptra*alptotcom; recompute total reduction and stress-attribution totals, or zero them when qred<vsmall.

state_mass_and_transaction_census.compensation_local_state: The compensation block uses ordinary local temporaries; it declares no SAVEd compensation history or prior-step continuation scalar.
state_mass_and_transaction_census.module_write: The Walsum branch writes module ALPHACRIT from current DCRITRTZ, RDM and RD_NODDRZ; Jarvis ALPHACRIT is configuration. Root vectors/totals are existing root-extraction results, not a separate receipt.
state_mass_and_transaction_census.reset: reset_rootextraction clears qrot, qpotrot and stress-result arrays/totals; it has no additional compensation-specific state to reset in this member.
state_mass_and_transaction_census.mass_owner: Compensation rescales the existing candidate root extraction. It creates no second mass transfer/receipt; enclosing SWAP5 acceptance remains unqualified by this source census.
state_mass_and_transaction_census.retry_rule: The pure compositor must take the pre-compensation candidate and recompute from that input every call. Do not mutate caller input or compound a rejected prior compensated output.
state_mass_and_transaction_census.micro_restart: MICRO compensation is source-rejected at read time; no MICRO compensation authority is admitted.
state_mass_and_transaction_census.multi_stressor: The exact legacy branch names oxygen/salinity/frost stress selectors, but their SWAP5 production admission remains independently held. D2 will only admit the Jarvis algebra on supplied already-authorized result terms.
